cohort: 855 women undergoing induction of labor (491 in the standardized protocol group, 364 in the usual care group)
finding: A standardized induction of labor protocol was associated with a reduced cesarean delivery rate and neonatal morbidity in Black women, thereby reducing the racial disparity in these outcomes.
mod_finding: A standardized induction of labor protocol was associated with a reduced cesarean delivery rate in Black women undergoing induction.
